sn15.13:1.2: Atha kho tiṃsamattā Paveyyakā bhikkhū sabbe araññakā sabbe piṇḍapātikā sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sabbe sasaṃyojanā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 3
sn15.13:1.4: Ime kho tiṃsamattā Pāveyyakā bhikkhū sabbe araññakā sabbe piṇḍapātika sabbe paṃsukūlikā sabbe tecīvarikā sabbe sasaṃyojanā ||
sn15.13:1.5: yaṃ nūnāham imesaṃ tathādhammaṃ deseyyaṃ yathā nesaṃ imasmiṃ yeva āsane anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucceyyanti || || 4
sn15.13:1.8: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 5
sn15.13:2.2: pubbākoṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ || || 6
sn15.13:2.3: Taṃ kiṃ maññatha bhikkhave || || Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ || Yam vā vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitam pasannam paggharitam || yam vā catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 7
sn15.13:2.4: Yathā kho mayam bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāma || etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yaṃ no iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsaratam sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitam pasannam paggharitaṃ || na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakanti || || 8
sn15.13:3.1: Sādhu sādhu bhikkhave sādhu kho me tumhe bhikkhave evaṃ dhammaṃ desitam ājānātha || || 9
sn15.13:3.2: Etad eva bhikkhave bahutaraṃ yaṃ vo iminā dīghena addhunā sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ pasannaṃ paggharitaṃ na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ || || pe || || 10
sn15.13:3.3: Dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave gunnaṃ sataṃ gobhūtānam sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ pasannam paggharitaṃ na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ || la || 11
sn15.13:3.4: Dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave mahisānaṃ sataṃ mahisabhūtānaṃ sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ pasannam paggharitaṃ || pe|| 12
sn15.13:3.5: Dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave urabbhānam sataṃ urabbhabhūtānam || pe|| 13
sn15.13:3.10: Dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave corā gāmaghātā ti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitam pasannam paggharitaṃ || pe|| || 18
sn15.13:3.11: Dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave corā pāripantakā ti gahetvā sīsacchinnānam lohitaṃ pasannam paggharitaṃ ||
sn15.13:3.12: pe || || 19 Dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave corā paradārikā ti gahetvā sīsacchinnānaṃ lohitaṃ pasannaṃ paggharitaṃ || na tveva catūsu mahāsamuddesu udakaṃ || || 20

sn15.13:4.3: ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tiṃsamattānam Pāveyyakānam bhikkhūnam anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti || ||
